name: @audsiui/dsh-minimax-coding-plan
description: MiniMax Coding Plan provider for DeepSeek Harness, authenticated with the MiniMax OAuth device-authorization grant
author: audsiui

scripts.//scripts: The build hook is prepack, never prepare. pnpm 11 runs only prepublish/prepack/publish when it builds a git-hosted dependency, but it *decides* to build whenever a prepare script exists. A prepare-only package therefore trips the allowBuilds gate and then silently builds nothing, so lib/ is committed and prepack keeps `pnpm pack` and `npm publish` honest.

//: Peers are concrete semver ranges, never the workspace: protocol. dsh's plugin manager reads this manifest and rejects an incompatible DSH peer *before* pnpm runs, and a workspace: range is unresolvable outside a pnpm workspace — which is where a profile lives. schemastery is pinned to the range dsh-llm-deepseek itself depends on, because this package composes its schema objects and both sides must share one instance.
//dev: A dsh package that must share the host's instance is declared in both peerDependencies and devDependencies: the peer is what the running harness supplies, the dev copy is what typechecks and unit-tests here.
